posts.author: Puch
posts.text: Just announced a contract to supply 5,300 MMBTU per day for the next one month. What is interesting is the contract is for 33 crores, or almost 2,300 per MMBTU. This is more than double the price that they were getting last year. image 643×570 71.4 KB

posts.author: valueseeker9
posts.text: Yes, earlier guidance was for 20,000 mmBTU, which has been revised down to 15,000 mmBTU due to the Iran war. Management seems pretty confident of at least delivering on 15,000 mmBTU, and prices have almost doubled since last year. image 747×162 11.9 KB
